entry_points: implementation/funsearch.py main(specification, inputs, config) (parses the spec for the @funsearch.run and @funsearch.evolve functions, builds a ProgramsDatabase, num_evaluators Evaluators and num_samplers Samplers, analyses the initial implementation, then calls s.sample() on each sampler; the first sampler loops forever)
implementation/sampler.py Sampler.sample() (infinite loop: database.get_prompt() -> LLM.draw_samples(prompt.code) -> random Evaluator.analyse(sample, island_id, version_generated))
implementation/sampler.py LLM._draw_sample(prompt) (raises NotImplementedError('Must provide a language model.'); the user must supply an LLM)
implementation/evaluator.py Sandbox.run(program, function_to_run, test_input, timeout_seconds) (raises NotImplementedError('Must provide a sandbox for executing untrusted code.'))

implementation/evaluator.py Evaluator.analyse(sample, island_id, version_generated) (trims the LLM continuation to a function body, splices it into the template as function_to_evolve, runs it in the Sandbox on every input, rejects programs that call ancestor versions or return non-numeric scores, registers scores_per_test in the database)

implementation/programs_database.py ProgramsDatabase.get_prompt / register_program / reset_islands (islands of Clusters keyed by score signature; prompt built from functions_per_prompt programs sampled by softmax over cluster scores with a decaying temperature; every reset_period seconds the weaker half of islands is reset and re-seeded with the best program of a surviving island)

implementation/programs_database.py Island.get_prompt / _generate_prompt (renames sampled implementations to <fn>_v0.._vk sorted by ascending score and appends an empty-bodied header <fn>_v(k+1) with docstring 'Improved version of ...' for the LLM to complete)
implementation/code_manipulation.py text_to_program / rename_function_calls / yield_decorated (ast- and tokenize-based Python source manipulation used throughout)

example.command: README gives none for the implementation; the only usage instruction is to open the notebooks in Colab (e.g. cap_set/cap_set.ipynb). The pipeline entry would be funsearch.main(specification, inputs, config) with specification = implementation/specification_nonsymmetric_admissible_set.txt, but it cannot run without a user-supplied LLM and Sandbox.
example.input: A specification: a Python program text with one function decorated @funsearch.run (e.g. evaluate(set_description) returning an int score) and one decorated @funsearch.evolve (e.g. priority(el, n, w) -> float, initial body 'return 0.0'), plus a sequence of inputs (e.g. (n, w) tuples). In-tree instance: implementation/specification_nonsymmetric_admissible_set.txt.
example.output: cap_set.ipynb cell 4 output for the trivial priority: '3 8 | 4 16 | 5 32 | 6 64 | 7 128 | 8 256 | 9 512' (n, cap-set size); notebook then presents the discovered priority function giving a 512-cap in n = 8 (data file cap_set/n8_size512.txt, 512 lines of length-8 vectors over {1,2}... e.g. '[1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]') and a 1082-cap in n = 9. The pipeline itself logs 'Best score of island %d increased to %s'.
